summary: The Speechmatics Startup Program gives early-stage, voice-first startups up to $50,000 in usage credits spendable across batch and real-time speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and on-prem deployments, plus monthly office hours with engineers, priority developer support, early feature access, and co-marketing. Eligibility: normally raised less than $10M total, functional MVP in production or committed launch within 1-2 months, not on a paid enterprise plan, active dev team, defined ASR use case. Cohorts are capped at ~20 startups; a 30-minute call precedes the decision. A work email is required: free-email applications are not processed. Teams above the funding threshold can apply with an explanation and may receive a compelling-use-case exception. Before applying, create a Speechmatics portal account and provide its email in the application; applications without an existing portal account are not processed. The form also requires phone, LinkedIn, company and use-case information, plus acceptance that Speechmatics may use the company name and logo in promotional materials if admitted.
claim_steps: Create a Speechmatics portal account before applying; the application requires its email and will not be processed without an existing account.
Apply at speechmatics.com/startup-program with a work email, phone, LinkedIn, company/product information, existing monthly STT hours and expected usage. Free-email applications are not processed.
Normally funding must be under $10M; explain higher funding for a discretionary compelling-use-case exception. Review is rolling, with a response within a few days.
Read the required privacy/terms consent, including permission to use your company name and logo in promotional materials if admitted. Marketing-email consent is optional.
Join the 30-minute use-case call. On approval, credits activate for eligible batch/real-time STT, TTS or on-prem usage.

social_proof.title: Speechmatics startup application email requirement
social_proof.text: Your application will not be processed if you use a free email address (e.g. gmail, yahoo, hotmail).
